policy: Saturday 00:00 UTC targets across the latest four months. Each engine pins its upstream default-branch commit for weekly main tracking and separately pins every eligible release in the window. Mainline measurements form a dimmed trend line; individually released versions are bold history points. Release eligibility: Wago beta releases, WAVM prereleases/tags, and stable releases for other engines. Measurements run on the recorded host and fixed corpus; collectedAt is never backdated. Repeated source identities can reuse verified measurements; missing releases, branches, and runners remain explicit gaps.
